sql:
SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
FROM cards c
JOIN (
    SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) as num_rulings
    FROM rulings
    GROUP BY uuid
) r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE r.num_rulings = (
    SELECT MAX(num_rulings)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) as num_rulings
        FROM rulings
        GROUP BY uuid
    )
)
AND c.isPromo = 1
ORDER BY r.num_rulings DESC
LIMIT 1
